arStrings.szText:
Dealing damage or applying Crowd Control with an {c_important}Eldritch{/c}, {c_important}Psyche{/c}, or {c_important}Growth & Decay{/c} Effect increases your Attack Speed by {c_random}[SF_0*100|1+%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} seconds, stacking once per category up to {c_random}[SF_0*100*3|1+%|]{/c}.{if:SF_9} 

While all three bonuses are active, you gain {c_number}[SF_1*100|+%|]{/c} Lucky Hit Chance.{/if}
Unlocked by finding a Forgotten Altar in one of the many dungeons around Sanctuary.
While all three bonuses are active, you gain {c_number}[SF_1*100|+%|]{/c} Lucky Hit Chance.
